title: WHAT IF EVERYBODY COULD SEE THEIR DAYS LEFT ABOVE THEIR HEAD?

segments.line: own timer glows with days . Your mother walks in . Her timer says What if everyone could see their days left . One fact : a Stanford study found people value time differently when they see someone else life . That s real . So what will you count ?

shots.note: Pip walks in, looks up; a stranger's timer glows above his head
close on the stranger's face; golden timer pulses above him
Mo walks in; her timer glows above her; Pip smiles
Pip thinks of Mo; her timer warms further; his own timer glows faintly
Pip's mother walks toward him; her timer glows 15678 days
Pip's eyes fill with tears thinking of childhood; both timers glow brighter
city at dusk; timers above strangers; Pip looks up
